#### `CLI-RESOLVE-ENV-03` — FAIL
**Verdict:** FAIL
- ✗ exit code is 0 | expected `0` · observed `127`; stderr `/usr/bin/env: 'bash\r': No such file or directory`
- ✗ APP_OFFSET integer 1..99 and ports shifted | expected N, 5432+N, 8000+N, 3000+N · observed empty stdout
  → root cause: the linked worktree checkout has CRLF line endings in scripts/resolve-env.sh (`git ls-files --eol`: i/lf w/crlf). The host has `core.autocrlf=true` and the repo has no `.gitattributes` forcing LF for shell scripts, so the shebang becomes `bash\r`. The main checkout is LF and works.
